name: Missy Elliott
hook: A Virginia songwriter and rapper who, with her fellow Virginian Timbaland, made strange, stuttering, funny records that sounded like nothing else on the radio, and became the first female rapper in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

blurb.age13: Missy Elliott was born in Portsmouth, Virginia, in 1971. She and Timbaland, from nearby Norfolk, were part of a group of young musicians around DeVante Swing of the R&B band Jodeci, and they began writing and producing songs for other singers together. Her first album, 'Supa Dupa Fly' (1997), was produced by Timbaland, and its videos, directed by Hype Williams, looked like science fiction. On 'Work It' (2002) she reversed a line of her rap so it plays backwards, over a beat that samples Run-DMC's 'Peter Piper'. In 2019 she became the first female rapper in the Songwriters Hall of Fame, and in 2023 the first in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.
blurb.adult: Born on 1 July 1971 in Portsmouth, Virginia. She met Timbaland through DeVante Swing's Swing Mob collective, and the two wrote and produced for other artists before 'Supa Dupa Fly' (1997), produced by Timbaland, reached number three; its lead single 'The Rain (Supa Dupa Fly)' and Hype Williams's Afro-futurist videos set her image. 'Get Ur Freak On' (2001) won the Grammy for Best Rap Solo Performance. 'Work It' (September 2002) layers samples of Run-DMC's 'Peter Piper', Rock Master Scott and the Dynamic Three's 'Request Line', Blondie's 'Heart of Glass' and Bob James's 'Take Me to the Mardi Gras', and plays one of its own lines backwards; it spent ten weeks at number two, held off by Eminem's 'Lose Yourself'. First female rapper in the Songwriters Hall of Fame (2019) and in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (2023).
